messages.text:
Hello HeliumDeploy,

So I had an idea for your magic miner.

We create viral content for it, run and manage the ads, and optimize the product page. But here's the catch, we'd only charge for the work if it got results.

Would love to send a longer email detailing the ideas. Mind if I sent it over?

Thanks,
Mike

--

Mike K.
CEO | Carbon Box Media
Handed to the team · Partnership/marketing proposal, not something I can accept or decline

Hi Mike,

Thanks for reaching out, and for thinking of the Magic Miner.

Partnerships like this aren't mine to decide, so I've passed your note to Georges on our team. Go ahead and send the longer email over in this same thread, with the ideas and how the performance side would work, and he'll have it in front of him when he picks this up today.

Thanks,
Sarah H.
